description: This Python source file contains utility functions for encoding and decoding video IDs with provider information, utilizing base64 encoding, and managing special cases for already encoded IDs. It defines functions for encoding video IDs with provider metadata, decoding such IDs, and extracting the original video ID, and references external modules for logging and type definitions.

classes.name: DecodedVideoId
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of decoding a video ID, including provider, model ID, and the actual video ID.

methods.name: str encode_video_id_with_provider( video_id: str, provider: str, model_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Encodes provider and optional model ID into a video ID string using base64 encoding, with checks for already encoded IDs.

methods.name: DecodedVideoId decode_video_id_with_provider(encoded_video_id: str)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded video ID string to extract provider, model ID, and the original video ID, handling malformed or unencoded IDs gracefully.

methods.name: str extract_original_video_id(encoded_video_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the original video ID from an encoded ID by decoding it.
